notes: Prerequisite `tech_id` values are resolved to {tree_label, tech_type, name_key, at_level}.
Prerequisite `building_id` values are resolved to {build_type, name_key, at_level, icon_sprite_path}.
English display names (e.g. 'Serpent's Rise' for tech_type 344 in Boss Boost) are NOT in the APK — the game downloads them from CDN at first launch.
Icons are extracted separately by extract_tech_icons.py — filenames match `icon_sprite_path`.
